categories.name: 3-Way Matched, Invoice After Goods Receipt
categories.description: Standard 3-way matching process where the goods receipt is recorded before the vendor invoice and invoice receipt, advancing value-matching control integrity.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative 5. Supported by frequent variants like V0001 and V0002 where goods receipt precedes invoice receipt.

categories.name: 3-Way Matched, Invoice Before Goods Receipt
categories.description: 3-way matching process where the vendor invoice is received and recorded prior to the goods receipt, helping working-capital efficiency.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative 6, realized in variants such as V0007 and V0008 where invoice receipt occurs before the goods receipt.

categories.name: 2-Way Matched (No Goods Receipt Required)
categories.description: Procurement closure using a 2-way match where goods receipt is bypassed, minimizing procurement and matching overhead.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative 7. Variants like V0003 conclude after goods receipt or bypass service/goods entries depending on the regime.

categories.name: Resolve via Consignment Consumption
categories.description: Resolution of purchase order items via direct consignment consumption, minimizing procurement overhead.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping to declared alternative 13. Service entry sheet and specific batch handling in variants like V0064 realize this consumption pathway.
